findings.title: Stop and join the reader before checking for failures
findings.body: Setting deletedAll does not wait for an already-running groups() request to finish. The assertion can therefore pass before that request throws and adds an exception, allowing the regression test to miss the failure it is intended to catch. Also, if any remove() call throws, deletedAll is never set and the non-daemon reader keeps issuing requests indefinitely, potentially interfering with subsequent tests or preventing JVM shutdown. Keep a reference to the reader, stop it in a finally block, and wait for it to terminate before asserting caughtExceptions.
